correctness.rationale: The sphere identity turns the chord deficit into the sublevel set ||X+Y||²≤4Rε−ε² for small ε. Compactness and uniqueness as a parameter pair localize to precisely two ordered patches. The signed-arclength Taylor expansion gives Tw+As² plus o(|w|+s²); its orthogonal tangential and curvature terms give a uniform relative squared error and confine the scaled domain to a fixed bounded set. The scales are s=(4Rε)^(1/4)x/√a and w=(4Rε)^(1/2)y, with unit Jacobian from (s,t) to (s,w). Almost-everywhere indicator convergence and constant patch density L⁻² give the beta area, the factor two and the uniform marked law. The marginal x⁴ has density proportional to z^(−3/4)(1−z)^(1/2). For Viviani x≥0 restricts antipodality to the two parameters π and 3π; the lengths and curvatures give L=8rE(−1), R=2r and a=1/r. The speed expands at each pole as r(1+O(u²)), so s=ru+O(ru³) and t=−rv+O(rv³); the cubic errors vanish even at the narrower ε^(1/2) scale of w. The exact symbolic coefficient is correct. Independent 50-digit beta/elliptic evaluation gives 0.1424415734315505169…, an immaterial last-place drift from the printed diagnostic decimal (difference below 7×10⁻¹⁷). The packaged finite checker was read, not run.
